title: Reading the Natural World: Observation, Inference and Responsibility
prompt: In many societies, people increasingly encounter nature through screens, guided tours and curated wildlife documentaries rather than through direct, sustained observation of local environments. Some argue that this mediated contact still builds care for the natural world, while others believe that genuine environmental responsibility can only grow from first-hand attention to ordinary places. Discuss both views and give your own opinion. In your answer, you should explain what you think is lost or gained when people rely on second-hand representations of nature, and you should state clearly which view you find more convincing. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有情境与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试题。请先通读题目，确认它要求你讨论两种观点并给出自己的立场，同时说明人们在依赖二手自然呈现时会失去或获得什么。写作时请用2至3个主体段展开：一段分析支持“媒介化接触仍有价值”的理由，一段分析支持“亲身观察更关键”的理由，再明确表达你的判断并说明依据。避免只罗列例子或写成数据描述；每个论点都要有解释和具体例证。注意保持正式学术语气，使用清晰的段落主题句和衔接手段，并在结尾重申立场。写完后检查是否达到250词、是否回应了题目中的两个具体要求。
